277753463.description: This Georg Jensen Zenta briar tobacco pipe is crafted in Denmark and features a smooth, polished finish that highlights the intricate grain patterns of the briar wood. The pipe has a classic straight stem design with a black acrylic or vulcanite mouthpiece. The bowl interior shows a darkened, carbonized surface, while the exterior has minor wear. The pipe is stamped with markings indicating its origin, adding to its collectible appeal.

277881781.description: This lot includes a variety of rough mineral specimens, natural crystals, geodes, and fossilized shells. Minerals featured include amethyst, quartz, calcite, and other colorful stones with natural crystal formations and geode interiors. The specimens vary in size, shape, and color, featuring deep purples, greens, blues, and earth tones. All pieces are in used, natural, unpolished condition, exhibiting rough edges and natural surface textures. Suitable for collectors, hobbyists, and educational use.

277827110.description: This listing is for a 4 lbs lot of assorted rough, uncut rocks, stones, minerals, and other specimens. The assortment includes various types of possibly other semi-precious stones. The collection contains both natural and a few tumbled stones, featuring colors from earthy browns and tans to whites, along with some unique patterned stones and a polished purple specimen. The stones vary in size from small fragments to larger chunks. All items are in raw, unprocessed condition, showing natural wear, dirt, and breakage typical of unprocessed mineral lots. Ideal for collectors, lapidary enthusiasts, or educational use. No specific brand or model is associated with this lot.
